music.title: Music · Rodi Kirk
music.description: Rodi Kirk's music: the duo with pianist Aron Ottignon, the Again remix on DJ-Kicks, and the score for the Sundance documentary Tickled.
music.lede: records, remixes, and films, made with collaborators around the world

items.alt: Still from the Funkhaus live session with Aron Ottignon
items.title: Aron Ottignon, Sam Dubois, Rodi Kirk
items.body: Aron builds motifs at the piano while I shape them live with real-time sampling, granular synthesis and custom code. As a trio we recorded an LP for Blue Note, as well as many improv performances.

items.alt: Cover of the Motor City Drum Ensemble DJ-Kicks compilation
items.title: Again (remix)
items.body: My rework of Again by Electric Wire Hustle, picked up by Motor City Drum Ensemble for his DJ-Kicks compilation.

items.alt: Theatrical poster for the documentary Tickled
items.title: Tickled (original score)
items.body: Music for the documentary. Part of a run of film scoring and placement work on HBO, Magnolia Pictures and Netflix.

education.title: Education · Rodi Kirk
education.description: Rodi Kirk on music education: Director of Music & Education at Melodics, essays for Ableton on practice, and teaching at dBs Music Berlin. Active learning.

items.alt: Playing along to a Melodics lesson with a MIDI keyboard and laptop
items.title: Melodics
items.body: The app that makes practice fun and habit, teaching drums, keys, and pads. I lead the content and learning side: from music licensing and production, to how practice feels, and how people actually get better.

items.alt: Artwork from Ableton's The Science of Practice article
items.title: Writing on practice
items.body: On repetition, flow, and the art of deliberate practice.

items.alt: Rodi Kirk performing at a laptop beside a grand piano
items.title: Teaching & curriculum
items.body: Academic work in music technology and creative production.

design.title: Design · Rodi Kirk
design.description: Rodi Kirk's design work: tides, a web artwork of the tide in Auckland; Small music machines, browser music games; and keys, a playable homepage.

items.alt: Tides: a soft blue-to-green gradient showing the tide at Cheltenham Beach
items.title: tides
items.body: A small web artwork so I know when it's time for a swim.

items.title: Small music machines
items.body: Pocket-sized music games that run in the browser. Daily seeded puzzles on a tiny shared engine.

items.alt: Flat coloured shapes from the keys sketch
items.title: keys
items.body: Every key is a sound and a shape, and mashing the keyboard writes my bio. One of the variants of this homepage.
